caption:
The 2026 Ig Nobel Prizes were announced on 3 September in Zurich. Five of the winning topics: defining a kiss, a splash-free urinal, buried underpants, cockroach 'milk', and why babies smell wonderful to their parents while teenagers do not. Details and full winner list at Improbable Research; Nature news coverage, 2026.

Source on slide 7.

#ignobel #science #funscience #research
